Interface EventObserver

All Known Implementing Classes:
EventCharacterBonusEffect, ShamanicExtraIconsEffect, ShamanicImmunityEffect, ShamanicWinMultiplierEffect
public interface EventObserver
Observer notified at each stage of an event card's resolution lifecycle. Implemented by building effects that interact with specific event types (e.g. granting temporary bonuses or immunity during an event).

All three methods have default no-op implementations so that concrete observers only need to override the stages they care about.

  • Method Details

    • eventStart

      default EffectOutcome eventStart(EventType eventType)
      Called immediately before the event's main effect is applied. Use this to apply temporary bonuses or flags that must be in place when the event resolves (e.g. extra shaman stars, immunity).
      Parameters:
      eventType - the type of event that is about to be resolved
      Returns:
      an EffectOutcome with any pre-event resource changes, or empty

    • eventPostResolution

      default EffectOutcome eventPostResolution(EventType eventType)
      Called immediately after the event's main effect has been applied, but before eventEnd(EventType). Use this to apply bonuses that depend on the event's outcome (e.g. multiplying a majority bonus).
      Parameters:
      eventType - the type of event that just resolved
      Returns:
      an EffectOutcome with any post-resolution resource changes, or empty

    • eventEnd

      default EffectOutcome eventEnd(EventType eventType)
      Called after the event and all post-resolution effects have been applied. Use this to clean up temporary state set in eventStart(EventType) (e.g. removing extra shaman stars or clearing immunity flags).
      Parameters:
      eventType - the type of event that has fully resolved
      Returns:
      an EffectOutcome with any cleanup resource changes, or empty
